name: EXM_SPEND_AUTH_LINES
description: This table contains detailed information about spend authorization lines entered by the individual.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTH_LINE_ID
columns.description: Expense line identifier that is associated with spend authorization.

columns.name: BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Spend authorization lines balance amount in ledger currency.

columns.name: CLOSED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the spend authorization line that is closed or completely cancelled.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person who created spend authorization expense line.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment identifier of person requesting spend authorization.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTHORIZATION_ID
columns.description: Spend authorization identifier.

columns.name: ITEMIZATION_PARENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Parent line identifier of itemized spend authorization expense. Possible values are NULL which indicates that line is not itemized, -1 which indicates that line is a parent line with itemization, and greater than 0 which indicates expense is itemized child line and value is parent line's identifier.

columns.name: AUTHORIZED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Authorized expense line amount in requested currency.

columns.name: REQUESTED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Code of requested currency for spend authorization expense line.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Functional currency code of spend authorization expense.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of expense line in spend authorization.

columns.name: JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: Reason a spend authorization expense line was incurred.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: First day of authorized expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last day of authorized expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Rate that represents amount one currency can be exchanged for another at a specific point in time.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Expense template identification.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identification of expense type.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies expense type category. Values are from lookup EXM_EXPENSE_TYPE_CATEGORY.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ATTENDEES
columns.description: Number of people who attended event for which spend authorization expense was incurred.

columns.name: TRAVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Type of flight, whether domestic or international.

columns.name: TICKET_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Cabin class of flight or ship. Possible values are BUSINESS and ECONOMY.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether spend authorization expense line violated company policy.

columns.name: JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether spend authorization expense line requires justification.

columns.name: CHECKOUT_DATE
columns.description: Date when person departs a place that is associated with accommodations expense category.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_DEFAULT_COST_CENTER
columns.description: Default cost center assigned to an individual.

columns.name: ZONE_CODE
columns.description: Zone code of zone type that is referred by spend authorization expense line. Values are from lookup EXM_ZONE_TYPE.

columns.name: AGENCY_NAME
columns.description: Name of company where spend authorization expense line for car rental was incurred.

columns.name: PASSENGER_NAME
columns.description: Name of airline flight passenger.

columns.name: FLIGHT_DURATION
columns.description: Airline flight duration in hours.

columns.name: TRIP_DISTANCE
columns.description: Total distance traveled during a business trip for which mileage reimbursement is requested.

columns.name: UOM_DAYS
columns.description: Number of per diem expense days calculated based on unit of measure.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: FUNDS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of funds returned by Oracle Budgetary Control API for  authorization request line. Possible values are from XCC_BC_FUNDS_STATUSES lookup. Example of values are IN_PROCESS, NOT_ATTEMPTED and RESERVED_PASSED.

columns.name: EXM_FUNDS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of funds relative to authorization request line. Possible values are from EXM_FUNDS_STATUSES lookup.  Example of values are ORA_FAILED, ORA_PASSED and ORA_WARNING.
